summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Aya Gold & Silver Inc., reporting results of its annual general meeting of shareholders. It shows nine director nominees were elected, with vote percentages ranging from 88.91% to 99.97%. KPMG was ratified as auditor, and the say-on-pay advisory resolution passed with 94.75% support. Two long-serving directors retired, and Ms. Ghislane Guedira was appointed Chair; women now represent 50% of the board. No transaction, tender offer, merger, or other special situation is involved. This is a routine AGM results filing and does not constitute a special situation event.
